facts.fact: Health Minister Mustapha Ferjani said on 29 September 2026 that the Ministry of Health aims for every Tunisian to have a unique health identifier and a digital medical record before the end of 2026, retrievable wherever the patient is treated, public or private, and hosted on a Tunisian sovereign cloud; this is a stated aim, with no coverage figure.

systems.platform: to be hosted on a "cloud souverain tunisien"
systems.tiers: not stated; aim is every citizen by end 2026, across public and private facilities
not stated; aim is every citizen by end 2026
citizen-facing portal in test phase: remote access to the medical record, appointments and test results; not in service

systems.owner: Ministry of Health, with Tunisie Telecom contributing
systems.tiers: more than 32 hospitals equipped for remote imaging during 2026; over 120,000 radiology examinations and over 3,000 remote consultations since entry into service

note: Sahetna is a patient portal onto the record rather than the record itself; classed emr on what the article says it does, and no fact taken from it because it is in test.
